toast.stillSharing: isshoni is still sharing. Stop it from the tray icon (^).
toast.micPrompt: {{app}} is using your microphone. Keep it out of your stream?
toast.browserMicPrompt: Your browser is using the mic (Discord Web?). Keep the whole browser out; friends won't hear any of its tabs. Tip: the Discord app works best.
toast.voiceAppsHeard: Voice apps can't be kept out right now, so friends hear everything, including your calls. Open isshoni to turn sound off.
toast.lockPaused: Sharing is still paused since you locked your PC. Resume sharing?
toast.stoppedLocked: Sharing stopped while your PC was locked
toast.stoppedSleep: Sharing stopped because your PC went to sleep
toast.updateReady: isshoni {{version}} is ready. Restart to update.

banner.exclusionUnavailable: Voice apps can't be kept out on this PC, so friends hear everything it plays, including your calls. Set your voice app to a different output device, or turn sound off.
banner.windowsTooOld: Update Windows to keep voice apps out. Until then, friends hear everything this PC plays.
banner.noOutputDevice: No speakers or headphones are connected. Friends hear nothing until you connect one.
banner.reconnectingSound: Your sound device changed. Reconnecting sound…
banner.soundOff: Sound is off. Friends hear nothing.
banner.soundPaused: Sharing is paused. Friends hear nothing.
banner.captureTrouble: Friends can't hear {{app}} right now. isshoni keeps trying.
banner.viewerMuted: Sound from shares you watch is off while you share sound, so friends don't hear themselves.
banner.viewerUnknownBrowser: isshoni is playing in a browser on this PC. Pause it there, or friends may hear themselves.

prompt.mic: {{app}} is using your microphone. Keep it out of your stream?
prompt.browserMic: Your browser is using the mic (Discord Web?). Keep the whole browser out; friends won't hear any of its tabs. Tip: the Discord app works best.

warning.sharedUsesMic: {{app}} is the app you're sharing and it uses your microphone. Friends will hear its voice chat.
warning.sharedKeptOut: You're sharing {{app}}, but its sound is kept out.
warning.sharedVoiceApp: {{app}} is a voice app, so its sound is always kept out.
warning.includedUsesMic: {{app}} uses your microphone and friends hear it, because you chose Include.

reason.pidReuse: Not shared, to be safe: Windows may count {{detail}} as part of it

sheet.voiceApps: Friends won't hear: {{apps}}. Apps that use your microphone are kept out too; you'll be asked.
sheet.volumeNote: Muting your PC doesn't mute your stream. Use Pause or turn Share sound off.

tip.ducking: Windows turns other sounds down during calls, and friends hear that too. To stop it: Sound settings → More sound settings → Communications → Do nothing.

soundCheck.failed: We couldn't capture the test sound, so friends would hear nothing from this PC.
soundCheck.deviceBusy: Another app is using your speakers on its own (exclusive mode). Close it, or turn off "Allow applications to take exclusive control of this device" in the device's Sound properties, then Try again.

sheet.title: Share your screen
sheet.picking: Choose what to share in the Windows picker…

dnd.title: Sharing your whole screen?
dnd.body: Turn on Do not disturb so notifications don't show up for friends. Allow isshoni in priority notifications, so its warnings still reach you.

panel.paused: Paused · nothing new leaves your PC; friends see "Paused" and hear nothing
panel.unreachable: Can't reach the server's media port
panel.minimized: Your shared window is minimized: friends see the last picture

details.latency: capture to send p50 {{p50}} ms, p95 {{p95}} ms

errors.seeWhy: Opens in your browser but not here? See why

share.unavailable: Sharing isn't available on this PC. {{reason}}

errors.invalid_argument: isshoni couldn't do that: something it was given isn't valid.
errors.io_error: isshoni couldn't open that on this PC.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.feature_disabled: This server doesn't support that yet.
errors.not_implemented: This part of isshoni isn't finished in this build.
errors.internal: Something went wrong in isshoni. Try again.
errors.invalid_address: That doesn't look like a server address. Check it and try again.
errors.server_unreachable: isshoni can't reach this server. Check the address and your connection.
errors.tls_untrusted: This server's certificate isn't trusted, so isshoni won't connect to it.
errors.not_isshoni: That address isn't an isshoni server.
errors.server_not_set_up: This server isn't set up yet. Its admin has to finish the setup in a browser first.
errors.incompatible_server: This server and this version of isshoni don't work together.
errors.too_many_servers: You've added 20 servers. Remove one first.
errors.not_linked: Link this app to the server first.
errors.publisher_offline: isshoni can't reach the server to start sharing. Try again in a moment.
errors.already_sharing: You're already sharing. Stop that share first.
errors.pick_expired: That pick timed out. Pick what to share again.

engine.permission_denied: Windows didn't allow isshoni to capture that.
engine.encoder_lost: Your PC's video encoder stopped working.
engine.source_gone: The window you shared was closed.
engine.no_encoder: No H.264 encoder works on this PC.
engine.dependency: Part of isshoni is missing or damaged. Reinstall isshoni from your server's Download page.
engine.audio_unavailable: isshoni can't capture sound on this PC right now.
engine.audio_not_running: Sound capture isn't running. Try again.
engine.timeout: isshoni's video engine didn't answer in time. Try again.
engine.internal: Something went wrong in isshoni's video engine.
engine.invalid: Something went wrong in isshoni's video engine.
engine.busy: Something went wrong in isshoni's video engine.

reason.driverTooOld: Update your graphics driver (NVIDIA 531.61 or newer).
reason.noMediaFoundation: This edition of Windows (N or KN) needs Microsoft's Media Feature Pack for video.
reason.blockedByPolicy: Windows (Smart App Control or your organization's policy) blocked part of isshoni's video engine.
reason.reinstall: Part of isshoni is missing or damaged. Reinstall isshoni from your server's Download page.
reason.deviceRemoved: Your graphics driver restarted, so the share stopped.
